controles.affirmation: Litige fiscal IRS : redressements de prix de transfert 2011-2016 initialement 244 M$ puis 431 M$ ; apres cloture du trimestre l'IRS remplace ces redressements et ajoute 2017-2018, portant l'exposition federale a environ 988 M$ a 1 224 M$ ; Expedia conteste et se defend en procedure administrative
controles.verbatim_source: Prior to June 30, 2026, for tax years 2011 to 2013 and 2014 to 2016, the Internal Revenue Service ("IRS") issued adjustments related to transfer pricing with our foreign subsidiaries. The 2011 to 2013 and the 2014 to 2016 adjustments would result in federal income tax of approximately $244 million and $431 million, respectively, subject to interest... Subsequent to June 30, 2026, the IRS replaced the prior adjustments and issued new adjustments for tax years 2011 to 2016... The adjustments, as proposed, would result in a federal income tax of approximately $287 million to $313 million for tax years 2011 to 2013, approximately $488 million to $531 million for tax years 2014 to 2016, and approximately $213 million to $380 million for tax years 2017 to 2018, subject to interest. We do not agree with these adjustments and will continue to vigorously defend our position through administrative procedures.
controles.correction_proposee: Verbatim exact, sommes justes (287+488+213 = 988 ; 313+531+380 = 1 224). La formulation 'initialement estime a 244 M$ puis 431 M$' laisse croire a deux estimations successives du meme montant : ce sont deux cycles d'audit distincts (2011-2013 et 2014-2016). Reformuler en '244 M$ pour 2011-2013 et 431 M$ pour 2014-2016'. Le vocabulaire est par ailleurs correctement calibre : 'redressements proposes' et 'conteste', pas 'condamnation' ni 'amende'.

controles.affirmation: La croissance du BPA dilue (+189%) depasse celle du resultat net (+166%) grace a la reduction du nombre d'actions de base, de 126,45 a 120,22 millions (-5%), obtenue par les rachats d'actions
controles.verbatim_source: Shares used in computing earnings (loss) per share (000's): Basic 120,223 126,453 ; Diluted 122,552 132,809. Note 4 : 'of our Convertible Notes using the if-converted method prior to the date of our irrevocable election to settle in cash'. Tableau dette : '0 % convertible senior notes due 2026 : — (30.06.2026) vs 942 (31.12.2025)'. Rachats : 4.2 million shares... for a total cost of $900 million (six mois 2026).
controles.correction_proposee: Le BPA cite est dilue, il faut donc le nombre d'actions dilue : 132,809 -> 122,552 milliers, soit -7,7% et non -5%. C'est ce -7,7% qui explique l'ecart (2,661 x 1/0,9228 = 2,88, soit le +189% observe). Et cette baisse ne vient pas seulement des rachats : les obligations convertibles 0% echeance 2026 sont sorties du calcul dilue. Reecrire : 'reduction de 7,7% du nombre d'actions dilue, due aux rachats d'actions et a la disparition de l'effet dilutif des convertibles 2026'.

controles.verbatim_source: we have seen continued interest in the online travel industry from search engine companies such as Google, evidenced by continued product enhancements, and prioritizing its own AdWords and metasearch products such as Google Travel, Google Flights and Hotel Ads, in search results.

controles.verbatim_source: Technological developments in generative artificial intelligence ("AI") tools are increasingly being used to create competing offerings, such as AI powered digital planning and assistance, further increasing competition.
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q parle d'IA generative en general, pas specifiquement d'outils 'tiers'. Nuance mineure.

controles.verbatim_source: Operating income 800 (T2) / 1,051 (S1) ; Revenue 4,315 (T2) / 7,741 (S1) ; Net income attributable 878 (T2) / 872 (S1). Recalcul : T2 800/4315 = 18,5% ; T1 251/3426 = 7,3% ; T1 net = 872-878 = -6 M$.

controles.verbatim_source: Should our credit ratings be adjusted downward, we may incur higher costs to borrow and/or limited access to capital markets and interest rates on our 4.625% senior notes as well as our 2.95% senior notes will increase.
